title: UAT Reporting ETL is one release ahead
detectionRule: Compare deployed versions across selected environments.
correlatedChanges: The UAT exposure scenario last passed on 2.3.8.
unknowns: Whether the version difference contributed to the failure.
recommendedInspection: Compare the ETL release manifest and failed execution step.

title: Latest FX exposure scenario failed in UAT
summary: The run stopped at the warehouse-load step at 06:44 UTC.
supportingFacts: Final report assertion did not run.
correlatedChanges: The expected UAT database route is absent.
counterEvidence: The same scenario passed in Production under older versions.
unknowns: The direct cause of the timeout.
recommendedInspection: Inspect route policy, ETL deployment and execution evidence together.

title: Expected UAT warehouse route is absent
summary: No harvested allow rule connects Reporting ETL to the warehouse on TCP 5432.
detectionRule: Expected deployment dependency has no matching allow rule.
supportingFacts: The ETL manifest declares a warehouse dependency.
No UAT allow rule was harvested.
correlatedChanges: The latest UAT scenario failed during warehouse load.
counterEvidence: Matching rules exist in Pre-production and Production.
unknowns: Whether an unharvested or dynamic route exists.
recommendedInspection: Review the UAT infrastructure plan and collector scope.

title: Trade Enricher evidence is stale
summary: Repository evidence is more than five hours old against an hourly expectation.
detectionRule: Last successful harvest exceeds twice the expected interval.
correlatedChanges: Trade Enricher is ahead of Production in UAT.
unknowns: Whether repository changes after 02:11 are missing.
recommendedInspection: Check the repository collector before trusting commit-level comparisons.

title: legacy-netting-mode has no current manifest references
summary: The toggle remains configured in three environments but no current deployment manifest references it.
detectionRule: Configuration exists while reference count across current manifests is zero.
supportingFacts: Present in Development, Test and UAT.
No current manifest reference was harvested.
correlatedChanges: new-netting-model is enabled only in UAT.
counterEvidence: Historical releases referenced the legacy toggle.
unknowns: Whether an unharvested operational script reads it.
recommendedInspection: Run the relationship autopsy before removal.

title: Pre-production retains Notification 1.8.2
summary: A retired deployment remains beside current version 1.9.0.
detectionRule: Deployment version is marked retired but remains present.
correlatedChanges: An old mail-relay rule still names the retired destination.
counterEvidence: No current request traffic is represented in this prototype.
unknowns: Whether rollback procedures still require the deployment.
recommendedInspection: Confirm rollback policy and the linked network rule before cleanup.
